name: Banded Ankle Eversion
regional_bias: fibularis (peroneal) group as the primary everters and lateral ankle stabilizers; a low-load prehab drill targeting lateral-ankle-sprain resilience rather than size.

name: Banded Ankle Inversion
regional_bias: tibialis posterior (primary inverter and medial-arch support) with tibialis anterior assisting; a low-load prehab drill for medial ankle resilience and arch support rather than hypertrophy.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Ankle-Stabilizer Focus)
regional_bias: tibialis posterior and the fibularis group as medial/lateral ankle stabilizers controlling inversion-eversion drift during a single-leg raise (gastrocnemius/soleus/plantaris drive the plantarflexion itself). Distinct from the gastroc-primary single-leg calf raise: here the goal is frontal-plane ankle control, balance, and arch/stabilizer strength.

name: Ab-Wheel Rollout
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis, lengthened-range bias

name: Plank (Front Plank)
regional_bias: whole anterior core, transversus emphasis

name: Stability-Ball Rollout (Anti-Extension)
regional_bias: whole rectus + bracing erectors (anti-extension)

name: TRX / Suspension Fallout (Anti-Extension)
regional_bias: whole rectus + bracing erectors (anti-extension); harder than ball, easier than ab-wheel

name: Weighted Plank
regional_bias: whole anterior core, transversus emphasis

name: Cable Side Bend
regional_bias: obliques and quadratus lumborum (lateral chain)

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
regional_bias: obliques and quadratus lumborum (lateral chain)

name: Cable Pallof Press
regional_bias: obliques (anti-rotation), bilateral bracing

name: Cable Woodchop (High-to-Low / Low-to-High)
regional_bias: obliques (rotation), diagonal anterior core

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
regional_bias: overall triceps (medial/lateral) with pec/front-delt assistance

name: JM Press
regional_bias: overall triceps (medial/lateral emphasis); heaviest of the triceps moves

name: Overhead Barbell / EZ-Bar Triceps Extension
regional_bias: long head of triceps (overhead stretch); heavier than the DB/cable versions

name: Overhead Cable Rope Triceps Extension
regional_bias: long head of triceps (overhead = long-head stretch bias)

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
regional_bias: long head of triceps (overhead stretch)

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
regional_bias: lateral and medial heads; rope spread adds end-range contraction

name: Skullcrusher (Lying Triceps Extension)
regional_bias: long and medial heads; partial long-head stretch (more if lowered behind the head)

name: Triceps Dip
regional_bias: overall triceps (lateral/medial emphasis with upright torso)

name: Triceps Pushdown
regional_bias: lateral and medial heads (arm at the side keeps the long head shortened)

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
regional_bias: brachioradialis + brachialis

name: Hammer Curl
regional_bias: brachialis and brachioradialis (neutral grip removes the supination demand)

name: Rope Cable Hammer Curl
regional_bias: brachioradialis + brachialis, constant-tension

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
regional_bias: brachioradialis (radial forearm)

name: Reverse Curl
regional_bias: brachioradialis / forearm and brachialis (pronated grip)

name: Barbell Curl
regional_bias: overall biceps (fixed supinated grip; both heads loaded through big-load full ROM)

name: Cable Curl
regional_bias: overall biceps; constant-tension loading ideal for high-rep and drop sets

name: Concentration Curl
regional_bias: short head / peak contraction; strong supination cue

name: Dumbbell Curl
regional_bias: overall biceps; supination twist option emphasizes the supination function

name: Dumbbell Twist (Supination) Curl
regional_bias: biceps supination emphasis (source's named example of loading the supination function)

name: EZ-Bar Curl
regional_bias: overall biceps with slightly less supination than the straight bar (more wrist-friendly)

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
regional_bias: long head of biceps (stretch-position emphasis)

name: Machine Curl (One-Arm)
regional_bias: overall biceps; supported, low-skill, easy to re-load for myoreps/occlusion

name: Machine Preacher Curl
regional_bias: short head of biceps; low-skill stable loading good for myoreps/drop sets

name: Preacher Curl
regional_bias: short head of biceps; heavy stretched-position loading

name: Spider Curl
regional_bias: peak contraction / short head emphasis

name: Banded Hip Abduction
regional_bias: gluteus medius/minimus and upper gluteus maximus; band tension increases activation but resistance is light/ascending

name: Banded Lateral Walk
regional_bias: gluteus minimus and TFL plus medius as frontal-plane abductors/pelvic stabilizers; band tension is light and ascending, so it functions mainly as activation and pelvic-stability prehab. Each step is a unilateral abduction against the band.

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
regional_bias: gluteus medius/minimus (frontal-plane abductors)

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction (TFL / Minimus Bias)
regional_bias: gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae; raising the leg out and slightly forward (rather than out-and-back, which favors GMax/medius) emphasizes the anterior abductors. Constant cable tension through ROM.

name: Banded Clamshell
regional_bias: gluteus medius (posterior fibers) + gluteus maximus external-rotation function; low loadability limits the hypertrophy stimulus

name: Hip Abduction Machine (Gluteus Minimus / TFL Bias)
regional_bias: gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae as deep/anterior frontal-plane abductors; an upright torso (vs. leaning forward, which biases upper GMax) keeps emphasis on the minimus/TFL. Full ROM out to a strong abducted squeeze.

name: Seated Hip Abduction Machine
regional_bias: gluteus medius/minimus and upper (superior) gluteus maximus fibers; lean forward to bias upper GMax

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
regional_bias: gluteus minimus and TFL plus gluteus medius; lifting the top leg with a slight forward/internal-rotation lean targets the anterior minimus/TFL, while a neutral/slightly-back lift favors the posterior medius. Loadable with an ankle weight or band for a real stimulus.

name: Banded Hip Adduction
regional_bias: adductor longus/brevis with adductor magnus; band tension is light and ascending, so best as activation/prehab rather than a heavy hypertrophy driver.

name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
regional_bias: adductor longus/brevis (frontal-plane adductors) with adductor magnus; single-leg loading lets the working leg start in a deep abducted stretch.

name: Copenhagen Plank / Adduction
regional_bias: adductor longus/brevis and adductor magnus of the top (supporting) leg, loaded heavily in a lengthened position; doubles as anti-lateral-flexion core work. A well-supported eccentric/lengthened adductor stimulus.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
regional_bias: adductor longus/brevis and gracilis (short adductors) with adductor magnus assisting; upright torso biases the proximal adductors. Open the pads to a deep abducted stretch for full ROM.

name: American Hip Thrust
regional_bias: upper gluteus maximus (American style upper GM ~90% vs lower GM ~57% MVIC)

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
regional_bias: gluteus maximus (short-lever knee angle reduces hamstring share)

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
regional_bias: upper gluteus maximus (highest EMG of the loaded bilateral lifts; ~82% MVIC traditional, upper GM ~87% vs lower GM ~70%)

name: Cable Glute Kickback
regional_bias: gluteus maximus (lower fibers, terminal hip extension); minimal systemic/synergist fatigue so very high SFR with short rest

name: Frog Pump
regional_bias: gluteus maximus (abducted/externally-rotated setup increases GM share, reduces hamstring)

name: Machine Glute Kickback
regional_bias: gluteus maximus; very high SFR (single leg, low body-support and CNS cost, short rest)

name: Machine Hip Thrust
regional_bias: upper gluteus maximus; very high SFR due to spinal/setup offload vs barbell

name: Reverse Hyperextension
regional_bias: gluteus maximus + hamstrings (terminal hip extension, low spinal load)

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
regional_bias: gluteus maximus + added gluteus medius (pelvic-leveling) demand

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
regional_bias: upper gluteus maximus

name: 45-Degree Back Extension (Hip Extension)
regional_bias: rounded-back/glute-focused or flat-back/hamstring-focused depending on spinal cue; very high hamstring (biceps femoris + semitendinosus) activation

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
regional_bias: whole posterior chain; relatively erector- and quad-dominant vs RDL/stiff-leg, with semitendinosus > biceps femoris within the hamstrings

name: Deficit Deadlift
regional_bias: greater bottom-range stretch on glutes and hamstrings than floor pulls; deficit sumo is a favoured heavy compound for glute growth

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
regional_bias: hamstring-dominant hip hinge; dumbbells permit a marginally larger stretch ROM than the barbell

name: Barbell Good Morning
regional_bias: hamstring + spinal-erector hinge; more semitendinosus and less biceps femoris than the RDL, with heavy lower-back demand

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
regional_bias: hamstring-dominant hip hinge; targets semitendinosus more than the stiff-leg deadlift does

name: Romanian Deadlift (Glute-Biased)
regional_bias: gluteus maximus + hamstrings at long muscle length; stiff-leg/RDL hinge ~40% GMax MVIC, glute share rises with a hard lockout and posterior hip drive

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
regional_bias: single-leg hamstring/glute hinge with extra gluteus-medius and anti-rotation demand; strong semitendinosus emphasis

name: Step (Deficit) Romanian Deadlift
regional_bias: highest overall posterior-chain excitation of the RDL family due to greater ROM/stretch; emphasizes semitendinosus and gluteus maximus

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift (SLDL)
regional_bias: glute-max-biased hip hinge (more than RDL); within hamstrings, semitendinosus still > biceps femoris but less ST emphasis than RDL

name: Sumo Deadlift
regional_bias: more quad/adductor and less lower-back demand than conventional; strong glute and adductor-magnus contribution

name: Sumo Deficit Deadlift
regional_bias: gluteus maximus with heavy adductor magnus involvement from the wide stance; the deficit adds bottom-range stretch

name: Trap-Bar (Hex-Bar) Deadlift
regional_bias: more quad-dominant and lower erector-spinae stress than straight-bar deadlift; load line through the body reduces shear

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row (Overhand)
regional_bias: whole upper/mid back; overhand + flared elbows biases upper back, rhomboids, mid-traps and rear delt

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row (with Lifting Straps)
regional_bias: whole upper/mid back; grip removed as limiter so target back muscles drive failure

name: Barbell Row (Underhand / Supinated Grip)
regional_bias: lower lats and teres major via the tucked, elbows-back path; greater biceps contribution

name: Chest-Supported Row (Machine / Plate-Loaded)
regional_bias: mid-back and lats with minimal lower-back fatigue; high SFR because torso support removes the limiting stabilizers

name: Gorilla Row (Bent-Over Alternating Dumbbell Row)
regional_bias: lats and teres major with anti-rotation trunk demand; alternating single-arm loading lets each side be driven hard

name: High Row / Cable Rear-Delt Row (Elbows-Flared)
regional_bias: rear delt, mid-traps and rhomboids — the elbows-high flared path Henselmans flags for upper-back/rear-delt bias rather than lats

name: Incline-Bench Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
regional_bias: mid-back/lats with no lower-back demand; neutral or pronated grip selectable to shift between lat and upper-back bias

name: Inverted Row (Bodyweight Horizontal Row)
regional_bias: upper/mid back and rear delt; difficulty self-regulated by foot position, good for higher-rep upper-back work

name: Iso-Lateral / Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Row
regional_bias: mid-back and lats; handle height/grip selects upper-back versus lat bias; very high SFR for a low-skill, low-systemic-fatigue row

name: Meadows Row (Landmine Single-Arm Row)
regional_bias: lats and teres major, with strong upper-back involvement; pronated grip plus the landmine arc loads the stretched position heavily

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row (Bench-Supported)
regional_bias: lats and teres major via a long elbows-back pull; per-side loading lets you bias each lat individually

name: Pendlay Row (Dead-Stop Barbell Row)
regional_bias: explosive upper-back / mid-trap and rhomboid emphasis; strict torso angle limits cheating

name: Seal Row (Prone Bench Barbell/Dumbbell Row)
regional_bias: whole mid/upper back with zero cheat; grip strength is the main non-back limiter, which straps can remove

name: Seated Cable Row (Close Neutral V-Handle)
regional_bias: lats and teres major via the close, elbows-tucked-and-back pull

name: Seated Cable Row (Wide Pronated Grip)
regional_bias: upper back — rhomboids, mid-traps and rear delt — via the wide, elbows-flared high-row path

name: Single-Arm Seated/Half-Kneeling Cable Row
regional_bias: lats/teres major with extra range; allows independent per-side reach and scapular protraction at the stretch

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
regional_bias: whole mid/upper back; fixed bar path standardizes the stroke and removes stabilization, akin to the Smith prone bench pull used in strap research

name: T-Bar Row (Landmine Row)
regional_bias: thick mid-back — rhomboids, mid-traps, teres major; neutral grip lets heavy loading with comfortable shoulder/wrist positions

name: Fat-Grip (Thick-Bar) Dumbbell Row
regional_bias: lats with added finger-flexor support-grip stimulus

name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
regional_bias: whole pec (balanced clavicular/sternal/costal); slight sternocostal emphasis vs incline

name: Bayesian Cable Flye
regional_bias: whole pec, deep-stretch biased; matches pressing internal-rotation pattern

name: Cable Flye (Mid)
regional_bias: whole pec (sternal); constant-tension peak contraction

name: Chest Dip
regional_bias: lower/sternocostal pec (with forward lean)

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
regional_bias: lower/costal (sternocostal) pec

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
regional_bias: lower/costal (sternocostal) pec, deep stretch

name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
regional_bias: whole pec, sternocostal emphasis; deep-stretch loaded

name: Dumbbell Flat Flye
regional_bias: whole pec, stretch-biased (sternal)

name: High-to-Low Cable Crossover
regional_bias: lower/sternocostal pec

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec; peaks ~30 deg, anterior delt takeover >45 deg

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec with deep stretch

name: Incline Dumbbell Flye
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec, stretch-biased

name: Incline Machine Press
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec

name: Low-to-High Cable Crossover
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec

name: Machine Chest Press
regional_bias: whole pec (mid/sternal); height of handles can shift bias

name: Pec Deck Machine Flye
regional_bias: whole pec (sternal); isolation

name: Push-Up
regional_bias: whole pec (lower bias); serratus-loaded via protraction

name: Smith Machine Flat Bench Press
regional_bias: whole pec (balanced); fixed-path sternocostal

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
regional_bias: clavicular (upper) pec

name: Weighted Push-Up
regional_bias: whole pec (lower bias); serratus-loaded

name: Leg Extension
regional_bias: all four heads; 90-degree hip seating biases the vastii (esp. vastus lateralis) over rectus femoris

name: Leg Extension (Reclined / Extended-Hip, Rectus-Femoris Bias)
regional_bias: rectus femoris (especially proximal/upper) emphasis from the more extended hip

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
regional_bias: rectus femoris at extreme length; lengthened-bias quad exercise

name: Sissy Squat
regional_bias: rectus femoris and overall quad at long muscle length; lengthened-bias exercise

name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR)
regional_bias: whole hamstring complex worked at hip and knee simultaneously; strong knee-flexion stimulus with a hip-extension component

name: Lying (Prone) Leg Curl
regional_bias: knee-flexion isolation biased toward the biceps femoris (both upper and lower portions); prone hip angle differs from seated

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
regional_bias: eccentric-dominant knee-flexion overload of the whole hamstring; strong biceps femoris and semitendinosus recruitment

name: Seated Leg Curl
regional_bias: knee-flexion isolation under hip flexion (lengthened hamstring); favoured for stretch-mediated growth and high-rep work

name: Standing (Single-Leg) Leg Curl
regional_bias: unilateral knee-flexion isolation; neutral-hip position sits between the seated (flexed) and lying (extended) hamstring length profiles

name: Dead Hang (Bar Hang)
regional_bias: support-grip finger flexors

name: Farmer's Carry
regional_bias: support-grip finger flexors; traps

name: Suitcase Carry
regional_bias: quadratus lumborum and obliques (anti-lateral-flexion), grip

name: Suitcase / Barbell Rack-Pull Hold
regional_bias: deadlift-specific support-grip finger flexors

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
regional_bias: gluteus maximus (deep lunge stretch) + gluteus medius stabilization

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
regional_bias: front-leg quad with deep-ROM long-length loading

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
regional_bias: front-leg quad; upright torso = more quad, forward lean = more glute

name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Glute-Biased)
regional_bias: gluteus maximus (lengthened position via forward lean + long stance) with gluteus medius stabilization

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
regional_bias: gluteus maximus + gluteus medius (highest GMax EMG of any reviewed exercise; a high box biases the glute)

name: Lateral Step-Up
regional_bias: gluteus maximus with heavy gluteus medius/minimus involvement (frontal-plane stabilization)

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
regional_bias: working-leg quad; higher box adds glute

name: Walking Lunge (Barbell)
regional_bias: front-leg quad; step length shifts quad vs glute share

name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
regional_bias: front-leg quad on short steps; more glute/hamstring on long steps

name: Seated Calf Raise (Dumbbell on Knees)
regional_bias: soleus (knee-bent bias)

name: Seated Leg-Press Calf Raise (Bent Knee)
regional_bias: soleus (knee-bent bias)

name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
regional_bias: soleus (knee-bent bias)

name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
regional_bias: soleus (knee-bent bias)

name: Donkey Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight, hinged-hip stretch)

name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee near-straight)

name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Stair / Step Calf Raise (Bodyweight)
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Dumbbell Stair Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Single-Leg Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Standing Calf Raise — Bottom Lengthened Partials
regional_bias: gastrocnemius, lengthened/stretched range

name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
regional_bias: gastrocnemius (knee-straight bias)

name: Tibialis Raise (Dorsiflexion)
regional_bias: tibialis anterior (shin, calf antagonist)

name: Overhead Shrug (Scapular Upward-Rotation Shrug)
regional_bias: serratus anterior + upper trapezius force couple for scapular upward rotation in the overhead position; trains lockout stability for pressing

name: Scapular Dip / Straight-Arm Depression
regional_bias: pectoralis minor (scapular depression / anterior tilt) with lower-trap and serratus co-action; a small-ROM scapular-control drill, not a mass builder

name: Serratus Punch / Scapular Push-Up (Push-Up Plus)
regional_bias: serratus anterior (the push-up-plus end range is its highest-activation drill); pec minor assists scapular tilt/protraction

name: Supine Cable Scapular Protraction (Serratus Punch)
regional_bias: serraty anterior (isolated open-chain protraction); pec minor assists; minimal glenohumeral motion keeps it off the delts/pec major

name: Wall Slide (Serratus Wall Slide)
regional_bias: serratus anterior in its upward-rotation role (overhead range); low-load mobility/control drill rather than a hypertrophy driver

name: Barbell Upright Row
regional_bias: lateral deltoid and upper trapezius (more trap as the pull goes higher / wider abduction)

name: Cable Cross-Body Lateral Raise
regional_bias: lateral deltoid, loaded-stretch biased

name: Cable Cuff Lateral Raise (Grip-Bypass)
regional_bias: lateral deltoid; grip fully bypassed

name: Cable Lateral Raise
regional_bias: lateral deltoid with strong loaded-stretch emphasis at the bottom

name: Cable Upright Row
regional_bias: lateral deltoid and upper trapezius

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
regional_bias: lateral (middle) deltoid; raising in the true frontal plane minimizes front-delt takeover vs scapular-plane raising

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
regional_bias: lateral deltoid and upper trapezius

name: Lean-Away Dumbbell Lateral Raise
regional_bias: lateral deltoid with bottom/stretch emphasis

name: Machine Lateral Raise
regional_bias: lateral deltoid; grip- and core-free so ideal for high-rep, myorep, and drop work

name: Band External Rotation (Elbow at Side)
regional_bias: posterior cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor); band tension is ascending (hardest at full external rotation) where the cuff is shortened

name: Cable External Rotation at 90-Degree Abduction
regional_bias: posterior cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor) in the abducted/overhead-relevant position; complements the elbow-at-side angle for fuller cuff coverage

name: Cable External Rotation (Elbow at Side)
regional_bias: posterior rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor) at the elbow-by-side angle; continuous cable tension loads the full arc better than a dumbbell

name: Full-Can Raise (Supraspinatus)
regional_bias: supraspinatus (initiates abduction in the scapular plane); the externally-rotated full-can path is the impingement-safer way to load it directly

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
regional_bias: posterior cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor); free-weight version peaks resistance near the top of external rotation and is light by necessity

name: Cable Front Raise
regional_bias: anterior deltoid, continuous-tension

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
regional_bias: anterior deltoid

name: Cable Cross-Body Rear Lateral Raise
regional_bias: posterior deltoid, loaded-stretch biased

name: Cable Cuff Rear Delt Fly (Grip-Bypass)
regional_bias: posterior deltoid; grip fully bypassed

name: Cable Face Pull
regional_bias: posterior deltoid plus external rotators (infraspinatus/teres minor) and mid-trap

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
regional_bias: posterior deltoid

name: Reverse Pec-Deck (Machine Rear Delt Fly)
regional_bias: posterior deltoid; minimal synergist so rest can be very short

name: Band Internal Rotation (Elbow at Side)
regional_bias: subscapularis (anterior cuff); band tension peaks at full internal rotation where the subscapularis is shortened

name: Cable Internal Rotation (Elbow at Side)
regional_bias: subscapularis (anterior cuff) at the elbow-by-side angle; internal rotators are strong, but this isolates the deep cuff component away from the lats/pecs

name: Lying Dumbbell Internal Rotation
regional_bias: subscapularis (anterior cuff); free-weight version is light and peaks near the top of internal rotation

name: AbMat Sit-Up
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis, emphasis on lengthened range

name: Cable Crunch (Kneeling Rope Crunch)
regional_bias: upper and mid rectus abdominis

name: Candlestick / Modified Candlestick
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis, lengthened-range emphasis

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
regional_bias: lower rectus abdominis

name: Decline / Slant-Board Sit-Up
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis, hip-flexor co-contribution

name: Hanging Knee Raise
regional_bias: lower rectus abdominis

name: Hanging Leg Raise
regional_bias: lower rectus abdominis

name: Lying Leg Raise
regional_bias: lower rectus abdominis

name: Machine Crunch
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis (loadable across all rep ranges)

name: Reaching Sit-Up
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis

name: Reverse Crunch
regional_bias: lower rectus abdominis

name: V-Up
regional_bias: whole rectus abdominis (upper + lower simultaneously)

name: Weighted Crunch (Plate / Dumbbell on Chest)
regional_bias: upper rectus abdominis

name: High-Bar Back Squat
regional_bias: overall quads with rectus femoris emphasis vs low-bar; deep ROM loads vastii at long length

name: Low-Bar Back Squat
regional_bias: more glute/hip; least rectus-femoris of the squat variants

name: Front Squat
regional_bias: strongest quad bias of the barbell squats; rectus femoris and vastii

name: Goblet Squat
regional_bias: quad-biased via upright torso and deep ROM

name: Machine Hack Squat
regional_bias: vastii-dominant; strong quad bias with deep ROM

name: Leg Press
regional_bias: vastii-dominant quad work; foot position shifts adductor involvement

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
regional_bias: per-side vastii-dominant quad work

name: Pendulum Squat
regional_bias: vastii-dominant quad work at long length

name: Smith Machine Squat
regional_bias: quad-biased; vastii and rectus femoris

name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
regional_bias: same as the chosen grip (pronated upper-lat / neutral / supinated lower-lat); regression tool to build to a free pull-up

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
regional_bias: same as chosen grip; band offloads the bottom stretch most, so it eases the hardest portion least near the top contraction

name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: upper lats and traps; produces no more lat activation than front pulldowns while adding shoulder/neck risk, so it is a lower-priority variant

name: Chin-Up (Supinated/Underhand)
regional_bias: lower lats plus heavy biceps (close supinated grip = shoulder extension; chin-ups are a notable biceps stimulus, comparable to curls)

name: Commando (Mixed-Grip) Pull-Up
regional_bias: lats with heavy oblique/core anti-rotation; the alternating-side path biases the lat on the side the head rises toward

name: Dumbbell Pullover
regional_bias: lats and lower pec at the stretched position; trains the lengthened position rows skip but loses tension as the arms reach vertical

name: Sternum (Gironda) Chin-Up
regional_bias: lower lats via deep shoulder extension in the contracted position; a contraction-emphasis bodyweight vertical pull

name: Kneeling Banded Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: lats with peak tension at the contracted bottom (band tension is highest there); a travel/home substitute for the cable pulldown

name: Lat Prayer (Cable Straight-Arm Pullover with Body English)
regional_bias: lats through their entire length, with the greatest resistance in full contraction; matches the lat's strength curve better than rows or pulldowns and trains the long lengthened position rows omit

name: Close Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: lower lats (close/neutral grip allows more shoulder extension, biasing lower lat fibers; neutral grip is wrist-friendly)

name: Reverse-Grip (Underhand) Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: lower lats with more biceps involvement (supination slightly raises biceps and lowers the lat:biceps ratio vs wide grip per Sperandei, but lat activation itself is statistically unchanged)

name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: full lat with extended stretch range; lets each side reach an unrestricted overhead stretch and bottom contraction

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
regional_bias: upper/outer lats (wide grip emphasizes shoulder adduction; Sperandei found wide pronated grip the highest lat:biceps ratio of the pulldown variants)

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Pulldown Machine
regional_bias: lats with a chest-supported, stable line of pull; iso-lateral arms let each lat work through its own full arc and fix imbalances

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
regional_bias: lower/mid lats with strong brachialis-brachioradialis involvement; joint-friendly intermediate between pull-up and chin-up

name: Pull-Up (Pronated/Overhand)
regional_bias: upper/outer lats (pronated, wider hand spacing biases shoulder adduction and upper lat fibers)

name: Weighted Pull-Up
regional_bias: upper/outer lats; a primary heavy vertical-pull anchor (RP pairs weighted pull-ups with barbell rows as the heavy back staples)

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
regional_bias: lats through shoulder extension with minimal arm involvement; the long head of the triceps assists as a shoulder extensor (straight-arm pulldowns can drive high long-head triceps activity)

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
regional_bias: anterior deltoid (also lateral deltoid when elbows flared); high systemic/core cost

name: Machine Shoulder Press
regional_bias: anterior deltoid; lowest systemic cost of the presses

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
regional_bias: anterior deltoid; lower systemic cost than standing variant

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
regional_bias: anterior deltoid with deep-stretch emphasis

name: Smith Machine Seated Shoulder Press
regional_bias: anterior deltoid; low systemic disruption (good for higher reps)

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl (Wrist Extension)
regional_bias: wrist extensors (forearm extensor group)

name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
regional_bias: wrist extensors, constant-tension

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
regional_bias: wrist extensors (forearm extensor group)

name: Barbell Wrist Curl (Forearms-Over-Bench)
regional_bias: wrist flexors (anterior forearm flexor group)

name: Behind-the-Back Standing Barbell Wrist Curl
regional_bias: wrist flexors (anterior forearm flexor group)

name: Cable Wrist Curl
regional_bias: wrist flexors, lengthened bias

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
regional_bias: wrist flexors (anterior forearm flexor group)

name: Finger-Rolling Wrist Curl (Dynamic Finger Curl)
regional_bias: finger flexors (flexor digitorum) at long lengths

name: Weighted Forearm Pronation / Supination
regional_bias: pronator teres / supinator (forearm rotators)

name: Hand Gripper Crush
regional_bias: finger flexors (crush-grip group)

name: Plate Pinch Hold
regional_bias: finger flexors + thumb adductors at long lengths

name: Wrist Roller
regional_bias: wrist flexors and extensors together
